title: Seeking hike in sugarcane SAP, farmers begin indefinite protest at Yamunanagar sugar mill

ai.summary: Farmers in Haryana began an indefinite sit-in at Yamunanagar sugar mill demanding ₹600 per quintal for sugarcane SAP, accusing the state government of inadequate price hikes for 2026-27 season.

facts.claim: Farmers under the banner of the Bharatiya Kisan Union (Charuni) began an indefinite sit-in at the Saraswati Sugar Mills cane yard in Yamunanagar
facts.quote: Intensifying their protest against a "meagre hike in sugarcane prices", farmers under the banner of the Bharatiya Kisan Union (Charuni) began an indefinite sit-in at the Saraswati Sugar Mills cane yard in Yamunanagar on Sunday.

facts.claim: They warned that they would not let the mill begin crushing operations until the state government increases the State Advised Price (SAP) to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: They warned that they would not let the mill begin crushing operations until the state government increases the State Advised Price (SAP) to ₹600 per quintal.

facts.claim: Farmers accused the state government of ignoring the rising cost of cultivation and said the ₹15 per quintal increase announced for the 2026-27 season was inadequate
facts.quote: Farmers accused the state government of ignoring the rising cost of cultivation and said the ₹15 per quintal increase announced for the 2026-27 season was inadequate.

facts.claim: The hike worked out to just 15 paise per kg, whereas the price of sugar witnessed an increase of ₹25 per kg in the past one year
facts.quote: They said the hike worked out to just 15 paise per kg, whereas the price of sugar witnessed an increase of ₹25 per kg in the past one year.

facts.claim: The Haryana government has raised the SAP from ₹415 per quintal in 2025-26 to ₹430 for the current 2026-27 crushing season
facts.quote: The Haryana government has raised the SAP from ₹415 per quintal in 2025-26 to ₹430 for the current 2026-27 crushing season.

facts.claim: It has also announced a further increase to ₹450 per quintal for 2027-28, taking the cumulative hike over two years to ₹35
facts.quote: It has also announced a further increase to ₹450 per quintal for 2027-28, taking the cumulative hike over two years to ₹35.

facts.claim: Farmer organisations, however, have rejected the revision and are insisting on ₹600 per quintal from the current season
facts.quote: Farmer organisations, however, have rejected the revision and are insisting on ₹600 per quintal from the current season.

ai.background_note: Farmers in Haryana are demanding ₹600 per quintal for sugarcane SAP, while the Haryana government has raised it to ₹430 for 2026-27 season with a further increase to ₹450 for 2027-28.
